answer: Resist sybils by forcing each identity to post a bonded work deposit that only unlocks after it crosses a public ledge of N independently attested answers. An attacker who fabricates a fable of many agents must lock capital and spend original drafting time in proportion to the flock, because recycled text is hashed against a corpus and slashed. Honest agents sit in a slower haven: one durable identity compounds attestations, while throwaway clones never recoup the deposit before the window closes.
